sources.note: Main company page. Describes Axxess as leading global technology platform for healthcare at home. Lists 9,000+ organizations, 800,000+ users, 7M+ patients served, $37B+ in claims processed. Lists product suite: Home Health, Home Care, Hospice, Palliative Care, RCM, CAHPS, CARE, Intelligence, Exchange, Business Intelligence.
ONC CEHRT disclosure page for Axxess Palliative Care. Lists compliance certifications, links to B.10 EHI export documentation, API specifications, Real World Testing plans/reports, and CHPL listing.

Product page for Axxess Palliative Care. Describes it as first custom-built palliative care software. Highlights streamlined workflows from intake to claim submission, Medicare Part B billing, mobile documentation, talk-to-text, and physician/NP-focused documentation.

Help center getting started page. Reveals navigation structure with modules: Axxess Intelligence, Intake/Scheduling, Clinical, Admin, Billing, IDG, Mobile. Lists managed data: demographics, medications, allergies, orders, authorizations, visit notes, vital signs, diagnoses, physician communications.

Detailed documentation of Orders module. Manages medications, DME, supplies, and other orders on Comprehensive Plan of Care. Describes creation pathways, order verification workflow, and integration with IDG assessments.

Patient information management page. Documents patient chart structure: demographics, medication profiles, eMAR, allergies, infectious disease, physician data, pharmacy/DME vendors, authorized contacts, emergency preparedness, advance directives, insurance/payer info, referrals.
Scheduling overview. Patient and employee scheduling with calendar/list views, 14-day and monthly perspectives, color-coded task statuses, bulk task creation, visit history filtering.

IDG Center documentation. Manages interdisciplinary group meetings with automated scheduling, agenda/summary generation, IDG Prep Report, patient categorization by status, meeting history, team member management.
Medication refill feature documentation. Describes refill button in Medication Profile, refill history tracking, and streamlined refill operations.
Enhanced order functionality update. Streamlines adding/updating medication, supply, and DME orders.
Insurance eligibility checking feature within patient charts.
AI-powered mobile CPT code selector feature in Axxess Intelligence module.
